title: Fractional triangle decompositions of dense tripartite graphs
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main results of Allsop, Bowtell, Lesgourgues and Petrova, "Improved bounds on completion of partial Latin squares" (arXiv:2609.37877, 2026): there is η > 0 (here η = 1/20000) such that every K₃-divisible spanning subgraph of K_{n,n,n} with minimum partite degree at least (0.769 − η)n has a fractional triangle decomposition (Theorem 1.3). Also formalized: the Farkas characterization (Lemma 2.1); the reduction to triangle-covered, balanced, untied and nonzero edge weightings (Proposition 3.1, Corollary 3.5), with Lemma 3.4 proved through an integral maximum flow; the non-uniform proportional discharging (Definition 4.1) and its two estimates (Propositions 4.2 and 4.3); and the numerical inequality g_d ≥ 1 for the article's piecewise-linear f (Proposition 4.4). The two-variable inequalities of Proposition 4.4, which the article settles by numerical minimisation, are proved exactly by Bernstein certificates checked in Lean. Not formalized: the article's Corollary 1.4 (completion of partial Latin squares), which also needs the fractional-to-exact transfer of Barber, Kühn, Lo, Osthus and Taylor for tripartite graphs.
